<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Declare which location types are legal in which zones"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/placement-rules"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Defines a PlacementRule: a LocationType, an Effect (Allow or Deny), and a zone predicate matching on zoneCode, temperatureClass and/or hazmat. Every field set on the predicate must match for it to apply (AND semantics); unset fields are wildcards; at least one must be set.

Evaluation at slot-registration time runs in order: any matching Deny rule naming the slot's LocationType rejects it (Deny always wins); if any matching Allow rule exists for the zone at all, the zone becomes an allow-list and the LocationType must be named by one of them; otherwise the zone is unconstrained. The rejection error always names the specific rule violated.

The referenced LocationType must already exist. Publishes PlacementRuleDefined.

  id={"request"}

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried POST safe (ADR 0019, ADR 0044). Clients MUST always send it: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`. A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response verbatim plus the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The key is global (not per route).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
